R308_evidence_summary: Phase-change valve response time 5.04 seconds, exceeding the 5s pre-registered limit by 0.04s. FAIL by narrow margin.
R309_role: REPAIR CANDIDATE — one repair attempt. Diagnose: mechanism failure (phase-change physics too slow) vs. implementation failure (parameters wrong).
R309_action_plan: Step 1: Diagnose using SIM_FEBIO. Is 5.04s a parameter issue (e.g., wrong thermal conductivity) or a fundamental phase-change physics limit?
Step 2: If implementation failure (parameter issue): repair parameters, re-run. If PASS, proceed through completion pipeline.
Step 3: If mechanism failure (fundamental phase-change physics limit): P-10 → cemetery. Replacement from reservoir.
Step 4: Document diagnosis with provenance (Article XXIX — separate implementation from mechanism failure).
R309_target_state: EITHER TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY (if parameter fix) OR CEMETERY (if physics limit) OR REPLACEMENT_FROM_RESERVOIR
machine_blockers: Diagnosis must clearly separate implementation vs. mechanism failure.
